geography: Paris, France: 24 deterministically selected road arcs

source.publisher: Direction de la Voirie et des Déplacements, Ville de Paris
source.timestamp_semantics: End of preceding one-hour source loop elaboration interval

protocol.mode: Rolling one-hour-ahead prequential forecasting of existing arcs
protocol.prediction_time: At target end minus one hour, assuming prior-hour count has already arrived
protocol.missing_targets: Excluded from supervised fit/evaluation; never filled with zero
protocol.missing_features: Native NaN for histogram boosting; fit-slice-only median and missing indicators for other estimators
protocol.preprocessing_refit: Train slice during selection; train + validation only during final fit
protocol.holdout_protocol: One frozen final holdout, no feature or hyperparameter changes based on its scores
protocol.online_lag_updates: Observed earlier validation/test counts may enter later predictions; no multi-day open-loop claim

features.lineage: Only arc category, known target calendar and source flow observations at strictly earlier exact UTC hourly timestamps
features.rolling_window_closure: [target - window hours, target), excluding target count

selection.selection_metric: validation MAE, then deterministic name tie-break
selection.final_refit: Refit only the best validation trained candidate on train + validation; holdout targets excluded; retain it even if a baseline wins selection

limitations: Foreign-city transfer benchmark; not a trained or validated Batam congestion predictor.
Only 61 calendar days and 24 smallest active arc IDs, not a representative city or seasonal sample.
No independently checked per-row detector fault flags; nonmissing source counts can still contain measurement error.
Zero publication latency is assumed because actual detector publication latency is unavailable.
Autocorrelated road-hour errors are not independent vehicle samples; no IID confidence claims.
No holidays, incidents, weather or road-change data were acquired for these measurements.
No generalization test to previously unseen roads; all holdout arcs occur in training.
The held-out period is now consumed for this fixed experiment; changing features after seeing these scores requires a new untouched holdout.
Interval calibration shares the model-selection validation slice and is not a separate conformal calibration set.
Hourly detector flow is neither exact camera vehicle count nor measured road speed, travel time, queue length or independently labeled congestion severity.
The serialized scikit-learn model is a local trusted research artifact; retain source attribution/license and exact environment when reusing it.
